title: Built so you can trust it

cards.title: Your tailor checks your numbers
cards.description: If a measurement looks off, your tailor asks you before cutting, and your answer updates the order.

cards.title: See it before it ships
cards.description: Bespoke pieces come with photos of the finished outfit, and you pay the balance only after you have seen them.

cards.title: Late means credit
cards.description: If a maker ships late you are credited automatically. If they abandon an order, it is cancelled and you are refunded.

cards.title: Your details stay yours
cards.description: A scan sends an outline of you, never a photo. Makers see only your short name and area.
